text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Hah! Color me surprised. Looks like... 
you've still got plenty in the tank.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
You would've been wiped out at this pace 
before. What did you do?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Secret training? Or did you pray to the 
Three Goddesses?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
It must be the influence of the shrine 
training— something that didn't exist in 
America.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—Training at a shrine was... surprising. 
In America, it would be—unthinkable.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Yet, the shrine's priest agreed. Without 
showing a hint of displeasure...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
In other words, the tolerance—of Japanese 
culture—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
It is all thanks to my Trainer's... 
guidance.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Is being... grateful to my Trainer... a 
bad thing?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Nothing. Seems fine to me, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
You'll join me for one more lap, won't 
you? You're confident in your stamina, 
right?
